newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stable in late trading on Thursday, with buying interest remaining thin amid falls in Malaysia, traders said.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,385-90 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening but higher than Wednesday's close of 1,380-85 rupiah. Offers were also heard at 1,380.
The traders said crude palm oil was done at 1,176 rupiah/kg exBelawan at a 500-tonne tender in the North Sumatran city of Medan, against the previous tender price of 1,165 rupiah.
"Prices are holding, but demand has not been very good because of falls in Malaysia," one trader said.

Traders also said production was increasing, especially from the end of last month. "I have been hearing that production has been very good," one trader said. "Several plants were running at full capacity and still could not process all the fruits they have been getting."

Data from Belawan Port showed the MT Swift Tiger will leave the North Sumatran port on Friday for Singapore with 3,500 tonnes of palm stearin. The MT Bunga Kesumba will leave for Dumai on Saturday with 10,000 tonnes of crude palm oil.
The MT Mutiara will leave for Cirebon on Friday with 2,000 tonnes of palm olein.- Arasu, Jakarta newsroom + 6221 384-6364
